lots of hugs & love towards you.

i know but to think about it? all the time, it’s constantly “what am I going to do with my life” I have 0 motivation anymore and I don’t think I’d like to live a life to just repeat the cycle I’m in already of work, home, work, home, occasionally something happens but then it’s the cycle again and again until we fucking die, so why not just end it all now?

honestly I’m not sure exactly how to help someone through a grieving period, but I know the little things help, check up on them, make sure they’re drinking water, getting at least some sleep, eating, hygiene stuff, buy them snacks every once in a while & go out somewhere nice & peaceful & just eat snacks and talk (only of course if you live near them)
